description: Finds the tools on this server that match a task description and returns their full definitions, so the right one can be called straight away. Use it first when unsure which tool fits, rather than guessing a name. Read-only and local: it searches the definitions this server already advertises, reaches Directus not at all, and so costs nothing against the instance. Matching runs over tool names, descriptions and keywords. Returns up to 10 tools unless limit says otherwise, best match first.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return (default: 10)

query.description: Free-text task description, e.g. "delete rows" or "change the data model"

name: search_tools
